about: The Echo Altar's elemental bows (its second wheel, 'Call a Bow'): one carried at a time, reforged like the spells. Each is a Skyrim bow (draw animation: whatever bow animation mod is installed) with its own model (tools/bows.py from the four bow basemeshes: mesh, body kind and colours), an energy arrow on the string, and shots that fly as the element's spell (spell: the spellcraft row whose bolt, burst, glow and effect it uses). tier 1 rolls from the start, tier 2 once an Echo Altar is woken. share: of a zombie's night health a fully drawn arrow takes (headshots double), grown by the night's power curve and reforging.

rows.label: Emberstring
rows.text: Charred horn strung with a thread of living flame. Its arrows set the dead burning.

rows.label: Rimehorn
rows.text: Glacier-blue bone from the Throat of the World. Its arrows freeze the dead where they stand.

rows.label: Stormreach
rows.text: Storm-blue steel that hums before the rain. Its arrows leap from one of the dead to the next.

rows.label: Skyhowl
rows.text: Pale ash strung with a captured gale, like the Tongues' storm-horns. Its arrows burst into a howling wind that hurls the dead away - drawn full, the bow itself looses a blast of wind that flings everything before you.

rows.label: Dawnspire
rows.text: Sun-gilded bronze of the old Tongues. Its arrows sear the dead and stagger them.

rows.label: Thirstbow
rows.text: Blood-dark yew that drinks what it strikes. Every hit gives you back a little life.
